where an offence is committed partly in one

where it consists of several acts done in different local areas, it may be inquired into or tried by a Court having jurisdiction over the local area in which first of such acts was committed

where an offence is committed partly in one
where an offence is a continuing one and continues to be committed in more local areas than one, it may be inquired into or tried by a Court having jurisdiction over any of such local areas
where it consists of several acts done in different local areas, it may be inquired into or tried by a Court having jurisdiction over the local area in which first of such acts was committed
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (D). where it consists of several acts done in different local areas, it may be inquired into or tried by a Court having jurisdiction over the local area in which first of such acts was committed.
